scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @ai-ads/shared && node scripts/prepare-local-dev.mjs && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,api,web --prefix-colors magenta,blue,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @ai-ads/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @ai-ads/api" "npm run dev --workspace @ai-ads/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @ai-ads/shared && node scripts/prepare-local-dev.mjs && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,api --prefix-colors magenta,blue "npm run dev --workspace @ai-ads/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @ai-ads/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @ai-ads/shared && node scripts/prepare-local-dev.mjs && npm run dev --workspace @ai-ads/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @ai-ads/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-ads/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @ai-ads/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ai-ads/shared && npm run build --workspace @ai-ads/api && npm run build --workspace @ai-ads/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @ai-ads/shared && npm run build --workspace @ai-ads/api && npm run test --workspace @ai-ads/api && npm run test --workspace @ai-ads/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
